HEATHEN-ONLY EVENTS (HE-01 to HE-45, draft for the owner, 2026-11-23, target v1.35.98)
New Believers only. Island events about the Heathens' own lives: honoring their dead, Heathen versions of events our villagers already have, and small moments of camp life.

collection.description: A Heathen's basket of noni rolls down the hill and into the tribe's side of the island.

description_variants.description: An Isolan's basket of noni rolls down the hill and into the tribe's side of the island.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (name1) trips over a root, drops a whole basket of noni, and watches it roll down the hill, past the boundary stones and right into the tribe's side of the island.

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (name1) creeps down to collect it and finds two villager children already picking it up. They hand (him/her) the basket, full. Nobody says anything. (name1) leaves a few pieces behind on a rock anyway.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (name1) decides that whatever rolls downhill belongs to whoever is at the bottom, and goes to pick more. (He/she) is a lot more careful with the basket this time.
